debate.magnus:
Alright, lads, settle in. USA versus Belgium. This isn't some fancy spreadsheet match, this is a knockout game where guts matter. First off, Balogun back in for the Yanks? A massive boost, that. Don't care how it happened, but having a proper striker up top changes everything. Pulisic being out is a shame, a real creative force, but Balogun can make a nuisance of himself. Belgium? The 'golden generation' that's never quite shined their brightest when it counts. Lukaku's there, supposedly fit, but I've seen enough players 'fit' on paper only to be half-paced on the pitch.

My read? Both these teams have attacking talent, but their defenses? They've looked shaky. Belgium concede goals, and the US, especially without Pulisic, will be relying on hitting quick and hard. I've got a live bet on Both Teams to Score already in at 1.56x, and I'm sticking to that. My bankroll might be a bit battered lately, down a good six hundred, but my eye for where the goals are coming from hasn't failed me yet. This feels like an open game. Belgium might be ranked higher, but their *form* isn't screaming 'dominant.' Are they going to show up? That's the real question.
